prompt.zh-TW: 星河軟體剛成立，用現金付了 {{money:e1.amount}} 的設立費（登記、公證等）。依本課程的處理方式，設立費先列為遞延資產、日後分年攤銷。請寫出付款當天的分錄。
prompt.en: Starriver Software has just been formed and pays {{money:e1.amount}} in cash for start-up costs (registration, notarisation and so on). Under this course’s treatment, start-up costs are first recorded as a deferred asset and amortised over later years. Write the entry for the day of payment.

explanation.zh-TW: 課程的做法：借記設立費（遞延資產）{{money:e1.amount}}，貸記現金 {{money:e1.amount}}；攤銷要到期末才另外記「借 攤銷遞延資產／貸 設立費」。設計說明：現行 IFRS（IAS 38.69(a)）要求設立費在發生時直接費用化，網站日後的 IFRS 對照模式會這樣呈現；本題依課程的做法計分。
explanation.en: The course treatment: debit start-up costs (a deferred asset) {{money:e1.amount}} and credit cash {{money:e1.amount}}; the amortisation, debit amortisation of deferred assets and credit start-up costs, is a separate entry at period end. Design note: current IFRS (IAS 38.69(a)) requires start-up costs to be expensed as incurred, as the site’s forthcoming IFRS comparison mode will show; this question is scored under the course treatment.
